fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical local commentary tied to Miami’s Palm Fete and visiting editors, with pieces on Congressman Wallace Dempsey’s remarks about Miami and Lake Mabel harbor development and on Gene Tunney’s comments about Miami as a restful destination. Coverage also addresses local business and civic concerns (banks, exhibitions favoring nonlocal firms, dock space and freight/shipping problems) and includes a warning about counterfeit Bacardi and dangerous liquor during Prohibition, with references to local law enforcement. Regular columns, society notes, and extensive local advertising for hotels, clubs, retail, and services appear throughout.
